description: Search More Hovels: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.
...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.
One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
